(async function(tab,n){const h=eval(load("helpers"));const q=await h.ev(tab,"[...document.querySelectorAll('a[href*="/jobs/"]')].filter(a=>/\/jobs\/\d+/.test(a.href)).map(a=>({href:a.href,text:a.innerText,card:a.parentElement.parentElement.innerText,status:'queued'})).filter(a=>a.text&&!/View|Apply/.test(a.text))");const path="job-search/wellfound-remote-frontend-page"+n+"-2026-10-13-queue.json";await h.save(path,q);const code="from pathlib import Path
import json,re
p=Path("+JSON.stringify(path)+");a=json.loads(p.read_text());t=Path('job-search/applications.md').read_text()
for x in a:
 n=re.search(r'/jobs/(\d+)',x['href']).group(1)
 if '/jobs/'+n in t:x['status']='previously tracked'
 if list(Path('job-search/founding-preflight').glob(n+'-*.json')):x['status']='preflight archived'
p.write_text(json.dumps(a,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps([x for x in a if x['status']=='queued' and not re.search('United States|San Francisco|New York|₹|Latin America|India|Canada|Austin|Miami|St. Louis|Seattle|Boston|Santa Monica|Washington|Atlanta|Burlingame|Redwood City|Los Angeles|Palo Alto|Alabama|Java(?!Script)',x['card'],re.I)]))";return tools.exec_command({cmd:"python3 -c "+h.q(code),max_output_tokens:2300});})
